gen-audiowide-fs-nunito: Soft, round-bowled lowercase carries the text, while Audiowide stamps out its headings like tiles with wide gaps between them. Nunito lets its terminals finish away from the stems, so paragraphs feel friendly and slide by without snagging.
gen-orbitron-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads with a gentle, brush-like swell in every curve. Orbitron does widely spaced, rope-fine precision best, while the serif does restrained brush modulation and near-capital small letters best.
gen-zodiak-fs-merriweather-sans: Dignified Zodiak swings hard between heavy strokes and feather-light hairlines. Merriweather Sans sits sturdy and tall beneath it, and that gap between moderate and high lowercase is the whole appeal.
gen-zodiak-fs-supreme: Heavy ink, hairline ghosts: Zodiak pairs dark thick strokes with near-invisible thin ones, a study in dignity. Supreme brings crisp weight: a dense strip of text, letters held open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-amiko: Ornate flourish, open-mouthed letters, and a tall x-height: that's Almendra Display. Amiko keeps things modern underneath, its tall lowercase and outward-pointing terminals giving the decorative heading a straightforward partner.
gen-audiowide-fs-merriweather-sans: Futuristic Audiowide sets its letters like tiles with generous gaps. Merriweather Sans carries sturdy, tall lowercase with an e that opens to the right, and that contrast in lowercase height is the real draw.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-solway: Chubbo draws its letters as if with a marker tip, casual and inviting. And Solway keeps its lines flat as stencil work, so text feels authoritative and bookish page after page.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-manrope: Snug and friendly: Pramukh Rounded bunches its glyphs close, bowls tipped open. But Manrope feels drawn with ruler and compass, leaving a bright, wide gap at every curve's mouth.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-fenix: Confident Oswald packs its lines into tightly knit rows, plainly strong. Fenix, a serif for text whose curves end before turning inward, does best with its size nudged up a notch.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-telugu: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. Anek Telugu adds wide, tall bowls that stay open like an unlatched hook.
